Guidance & outlook: Revenue has seen quantum jump from ₹795 crore in FY25 to ₹ 986 crore in FY26, a rise of nearly 24%.

The Sulphuric Acid plant at our new Cuddalore facility became commercially Building Resilience through Strategic Integration Financial Milestones Revenue for FY26 has increased to ₹986 crore on a standalone basis, up from ₹800.46 crore in FY25, an increase of 23.2%.

Our 0.75 MW solar power plant at Bikaner, commissioned in FY 2022-23, continued to supply a significant share of our Udaipur plant's captive power requirement through FY 2025-26, supporting both our emissions-reduction goals and our energy cost base.
Growth & demand: Responsible Growth Over 80% of our fertilizer output today is micronutrient fortified, a figure we are proud of because it reflects a choice to serve long term soil health over short term volume.

Revenue from operations grew by approximately 23% year-on-year, from ₹871.90 crore in FY 2024-25 to ₹1,072.33 crore in FY 2025-26, supported by remunerative SSP pricing, firm demand across the Company's core geographies, and improved realisations from sulphuric acid sales amid constrained domestic availability.

The Company's Debt-to-Equity ratio improved marginally to 0.41% from 0.49%, continuing the deleveraging trend evident since FY 2023-24 (when the ratio stood at 1.09%), and reflecting a more conservative capital structure as the Company funds its growth initiatives.
Margins & costs: As multimodal transfer points mature and see higher utilisation, the India's phosphatic fertilizer segment remains heavily import dependent, with industry estimates placing net import reliance on phosphatic raw materials in the region of 80 to 90%, sourced principally from China, Saudi Arabia, Morocco, Jordan and Egypt.
EBITDA more than doubled, rising by approximately 118% to ₹45.19 crore from ₹20.69 crore in the previous year, with EBITDA margin expanding from 2.37% to 4.12%.

Capex & expansion: In July 2025, our Greenfield manufacturing facility in Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu, achieved a major milestone with the commissioning of the Sulphuric Acid Plant.
